sources.shortCitation: Domgraf-Fassbaender, “Schön ist das ganze Leben” (Jube Pops reissue, via YouTube)
sources.fullCitation: Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender, with the Marek Weber Orchestra conducted by Marek Weber. “Der gluckliche Herr Funf: Schon ist das ganze Leben.” Music by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann, words by Fritz Rotter. On Schlager und Filmmelodien von Walter Jurmann, Vol. 2 (Recordings 1929–1936). Jube Pops, released 5 February 2013; art track supplied to YouTube by Naxos Digital Services and published on the auto-generated artist channel on 11 February 2015. The reissue does not identify the original disc. Accessed 15 August 2026.

media.title: Schön ist das ganze Leben — Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender, listening reference
media.description: Recording of “Schön ist das ganze Leben” sung by Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender with the Marek Weber Orchestra, reissued by Jube Pops and linked as an external listening reference.
media.altText: Listening reference for “Schön ist das ganze Leben” sung by Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender.
media.rightsNote: The recording is not rehosted: the link points to the rights holder's own upload. The transfer carries a 2013 phonogram claim by Jube Pops, distributed through Naxos Digital Services, over a recording made in the early 1930s; reuse of the transfer would need their permission, and the status of the original recording is not established here.
media.publicCaption: Listening reference for “Schön ist das ganze Leben” sung by Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender with the Marek Weber Orchestra under Marek Weber, from the Jube Pops compilation Schlager und Filmmelodien von Walter Jurmann, Vol. 2 (Recordings 1929–1936), supplied to YouTube by Naxos Digital Services. The reissue does not identify the original disc; this is an access copy, not rights evidence.
